children: Volkswagen plans to build a new factory for its Audi brand in Georgia and expand an existing facility in South Carolina, a U.S. official said. According to Sina Finance, the new plant in Macon will produce the Audi Q7, Q8 and Q9, with annual capacity of 200,000 vehicles. U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to formally announce the investment on Saturday, while U.S. officials continue negotiating tariff relief for automakers that expand domestic production.

title: Volkswagen Plans New Audi Factory in Georgia
